verdict_reason: Records now carry a use and two tests moved to the seeded helper, but two tests still hand-walk to the Consignor picker that animalsJourney.toPartyPicker owns.

todos.issue: Two tests walk to the Consignor picker step by step with the same sequence (lines 22-28: startNotification, answerCommodity, overview task 'Roles and addresses', addParty('Consignor'); and lines 80-84, the same), although flows/animals/journey.ts already owns it as animalsJourney.toPartyPicker(role) (journey.ts:567-573). The PR moved the other two tests in this file onto animalsSeededJourney.createDraftWithConsignorChosenInUi but left these two copies beside it.
